title: Embedding INT8/FP16 Stability Playbook — Calibration, Profiles, and Cosine-Drift Guardrails
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a repeatable playbook to (1) generate calibration profiles for embedding models under INT8 and FP16 quantization, (2) run a robust calibration workflow that produces layer-wise scale factors and per-channel clips, and (3) validate accuracy by running cosine-similarity drift checks and downstream retrieval/regression tests. The goal is to ship quant profiles and automation so we can deploy INT8/FP16 embedding variants with measurable, bounded quality regressions and runtime guardrails.
acceptance_criteria: Automated calibration pipeline that emits a named profile (profile_id) for INT8 and FP16 with layer metadata and an artifact stored in s3://redwood-quant/profiles/
Baseline FP32->INT8/FP16 validation harness that computes pairwise cosine similarity against FP32 references for a 50k-sample calibration set
Mean cosine similarity drop (FP32 vs quantized) <= 0.02 and 95th-percentile drop <= 0.05 for production embeddings on the canonical dataset
Downstream retrieval MRR drop <= 1.5% (absolute) on internal eval suites, or rollback to baseline profile if exceeded
Nightly drift job that runs on new traffic and triggers an alert when the 99th-percentile cosine drop vs baseline exceeds 0.06
Runtime fallback policy in serving: if per-request confidence metric (norm deviation or similarity proxy) indicates high sensitivity, route to FP32/FP16-safe path
Documentation and example scripts checked in (docs + one tutorial PR) and reviewed by PM and Applied ML
calibration_protocol: Assemble calibration corpus: 50k representative embedding inputs sampled across product vectors (docs, queries, chat prompts, short/long) with dedupe and stratified domain sampling
Compute FP32 reference embeddings using the canonical runtime and seed. Persist embeddings with metadata (source_id, timestamp, input_hash) to s3://redwood-quant/calibration/refs/

Run activation-collector pass: feed calibration samples through model to record per-layer activation min/max and second-moment stats (per-channel where supported). Persist collectors as .npy artifacts.

Quant candidate generation: run quantizer for candidate modes: symmetric per-channel INT8, asymmetric per-tensor INT8, and FP16 mixed config. Produce layer-wise scale/zero-point maps and candidate model binaries (quantized artifacts).

Post-quant forward: compute embeddings for each candidate using same batching policy. Ensure same tokenization & padding semantics. Store candidate embeddings under s3://redwood-quant/calibration/candidates/{profile_id}/

Cosine drift analysis: compute pairwise cosine similarity between FP32 reference and each candidate embedding. Bucket by original length/norm/domain and compute mean/median/percentiles. Persist report JSON.

Profile selection: automatically score candidates by weighted metric (mean_cosine_drop * 0.6 + p95_drop * 0.3 + retrieval_delta * 0.1). Promote top candidate as staging profile and tag with metadata (dataset, commit hash, quant parameters).
Generate compatibility metadata: record ops not supported by some runtimes and a runtime capability matrix for fallback routing.
evaluation_metrics: Mean cosine similarity (FP32 vs quant) — target >= 0.98 (drop <= 0.02)
Median cosine similarity and p95/p99 drops for tail risk analysis
Retrieval metrics (MRR@10, Recall@k) measured on labeled eval sets
Embedding L2/norm distribution shift — monitor mean and stdev relative to FP32 baseline
Downstream classifier AUC for any supervised probes used internally
Percent of queries with cosine similarity drop > 0.05 (target < 3%)
monitoring_checks: Nightly drift job: run 10k-sample delta job vs canonical FP32 refs and compute p95/p99 drift. Create alert when p99_drift > 0.06 or mean_drift > 0.03.
Realtime anomaly sampling: for a 1% sampling of production requests compute a lightweight similarity proxy (sketch-based) and flag sudden shifts in norm distribution
Profile health dashboard: tokenized per-profile MRR trend, cosine histogram, and recent commits that changed profile_id
Alert routing: SLO violation -> #infra-quant on Slack + high-priority page to oncall, with automated runbook link
Automated rollback: if a release causes a 24-hour weighted regret > threshold we auto-tag release for rollback and open ENG rollback ticket
rollout_plan: 1) Internally stage selected profile on 'staging-dedicated' for 48h; run full eval harness (embedding matching, retrieval MRR, norm checks).
2) Canary 5% traffic in hosted region with latency/cost gating; monitor drift and user-facing error rates for 72h.
3) Expand to 25% with watchful monitoring and expanded evaluation coverage. If any metric breaches acceptance_criteria, trigger auto-rollback policy.
4) Promote to 100% and mark profile as 'stable' with metadata and TTL (profile revalidation every 14 days).
